topic: Milestone A: original 00437F90 camera orientation helper contract and world-node constructor basis initialization
summary: Static retail disassembly and original-instruction Ghidra isolated tests recover 00437F90 as a class-1 stateful camera-basis helper with two camera callers and no own ancestor traversal. Original 0045EBD0 initializes root direction to nonzero identity basis; erasing it yields 9 NaN float words via unguarded projection. Eight controlled scenarios and 134 assertions validate the scoped claim; full camera numeric parity remains open.

reproducibility.limitations: Controlled class-1 runtime vectors/angles and frame delta; original Win32 HeapAlloc result is intercepted, and prior full VCF/camera never reexecuted with root fix. Original reciprocal-sqrt approximator 00495000 uses Ghidra program-memory lookup representation; no hardware x87 parity, authentic world pose, full player-camera timing, collision, raster or pixels. Private original binaries/GZF and local result traces needed for exact replay, not published.
